decisions.reason: As a newly launched machine that fits the firm's publicly stated push toward integrated and automated precast production, we would continue backing it because recent engineering and market-introduction investments are high and any weak early uptake can still be interpreted as temporary adoption frictions.

We would keep the production analysis software because it strengthens the firm's move toward future-ready, data-driven plant solutions, builds on existing control and service capabilities, and the firm is likely to justify its recent visible commitment by giving the product more time to gain traction.
